response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced, versatile senior/staff engineer with 15+ years shipping production software across web, backend, mobile and embedded, plus strong TypeScript, testing and DevOps credentials. However, the role's core requirement — 8+ years building production AI/GenAI solutions — is not met; his AI-relevant work appears limited to roughly one year of MCP code generators and agentic tooling at re:cinq. There is no evidence of Python, vector databases, RAG architectures, evaluation/observability pipelines for LLMs, multi-agent frameworks, or data pipelines for unstructured data, and cloud exposure is narrow (AWS CDK). He could be a fit for a platform/tooling engineer supporting GenAI, but is a stretch for a Staff Forward Deployed GenAI Engineer without a targeted screen on his MCP/agent work.
strengths: 15+ years of production engineering, strong TypeScript/Node depth
Hands-on MCP and agentic developer tooling experience at re:cinq
Proven mentoring, workshops, and open-source technical leadership
concerns: No demonstrated RAG, vector DB, or LLM evaluation experience
Python absent from skills; AI experience roughly one year, not eight
Limited customer-facing consulting/discovery evidence and shallow cloud AI work

key_factors.factor: Depth of general engineering and staff-level seniority
